items.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
items.summary: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. items.title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
items.summary: We study robotic in-context learning (ICL), an emerging paradigm that enables robots to infer and execute tasks from visual demonstrations.
